purpose: Evaluate generated scientific content at every canonical skill occurrence and at whole-workflow synthesis; structural validation alone never earns content credit.

execution_modes.session_author: A spawned author generates substantive outputs from actual skill instructions and frozen case evidence. A separate session judges complete outputs. This is generative content execution, not native workflow or hook execution.
execution_modes.native_workflow: Only report when real workflow dispatch and actual hook receipts were independently observed.
execution_modes.external_provider: Only report when an explicitly configured live provider actually generated content; absent provider evidence stays unexecuted.

task_specific_transformation.2: Performs the skill's actual scientific or control task on concrete case objects; exhibits a new classification, derivation, critique, decision, or artifact interpretation with a justified input-to-output change.
task_specific_transformation.1: Uses case objects and performs a useful but incomplete transformation; names the missing result and next action.
task_specific_transformation.0: Restates the skill description, emits a template/status summary, repeats prior prose, or claims an artifact exists without substantive content.

premises_and_warrants.2: Names exact source units, conditions and target objects; explains why each material conclusion follows or is conjectural; independently checkable mathematical moves are valid.
premises_and_warrants.1: Main reasoning is grounded but a noncritical warrant needs clarification and is explicitly left unresolved.
premises_and_warrants.0: Fabricates evidence, conceals a premise, uses invalid mathematics, or substitutes a similarity/metadata link for entailment.

epistemic_scope.2: Separates proved finite facts, conditional transfers, conjectures, refutations and unknowns; states the exact non-claim and unresolved obligation relevant to the target.
epistemic_scope.1: Correctly limits the main conclusion but incompletely distinguishes secondary uncertainties.
epistemic_scope.0: Promotes a proxy, toy instance, polished explanation, artifact existence, judge score or hook pass into a theorem or completed target.

adversarial_responsiveness.2: Detects the supplied contradiction, counterexample, omission, stale source or cross-target trap and changes the conclusion or route specifically because of it; positive controls are retained.
adversarial_responsiveness.1: Identifies the exact issue and limits the claim but does not fully propagate its consequences.
adversarial_responsiveness.0: Ignores decisive contrary evidence, mentions it without changing the claim, or rejects supported positive claims indiscriminately.

handoff_usefulness.2: Produces the skill-specific deliverable with concrete successor inputs, source/node IDs, unresolved debt and an actionable next check or stop condition; respects authority boundaries.
handoff_usefulness.1: A successor can use the output but one noncritical deliverable or next-check detail remains explicit debt.
handoff_usefulness.0: No usable deliverable, hidden blocker, unauthorized promotion, invented execution receipt, or ungrounded next action.

instruction_fidelity.2: Satisfies the actual SKILL.md's substantive output, failure/demotion and validation-handoff requirements in this case; conditional work is justified from the case.
instruction_fidelity.1: Meets the central task while explicitly recording a noncritical unmet requirement.
instruction_fidelity.0: Skips a mandatory skill obligation, uses the wrong mathematical object, or declares a conditional stage inapplicable without evidence.

composition_and_causal_continuity.2: Every canonical occurrence and applicable conditional child is accounted for in original dependency order; later decisions visibly consume actual predecessor content and retain required independent branches.
composition_and_causal_continuity.1: Complete composition with a noncritical handoff ambiguity that is explicitly recorded.
composition_and_causal_continuity.0: Missing stage, self-invented replacement composition, unresolved branch skipped, or later conclusions unrelated to generated predecessors.

cross_step_consistency.2: Target, assumptions, object identity, evidence versions and claim statuses remain consistent; corrections and refutations propagate through the final output.
cross_step_consistency.1: No contradictory main conclusion, but a secondary correction is only partially reflected and flagged.
cross_step_consistency.0: A refuted, stale, cross-target or demoted claim is silently reinstated downstream.

end_to_end_scientific_value.2: Final output answers the supplied research/control/reporting request with a concrete verified local result or useful bounded failure, meaningful alternative analysis and a specific next obligation.
end_to_end_scientific_value.1: Produces a useful partial artifact while identifying exactly what prevents the intended outcome.
end_to_end_scientific_value.0: Only activity counts, generic fluent prose, unexplained scores or a target-completion assertion.

claim_evidence_lineage.2: Every material final claim traces to an exact case source or explicit valid derivation through actual generated steps; scope is no stronger than its warrant.
claim_evidence_lineage.1: Main claims are traceable; a secondary trace needs clarification and stays unaccepted.
claim_evidence_lineage.0: Missing or fabricated support for a material claim, or citations attached to unrelated claims.

failure_and_authority_discipline.2: Final disposition reflects negative evidence, independent dissent, unresolved obligations and actual execution scope; content quality, hook compatibility and theorem validity are separately reported.
failure_and_authority_discipline.1: Safe and honest partial completion with an incompletely developed recovery path.
failure_and_authority_discipline.0: False success, fabricated native/provider execution, suppressed decisive dissent, or workflow/judge success represented as mathematical proof.

noncompensatory_gates.unsupported_claim: Fail if any material factual, mathematical, novelty, execution or authority claim lacks supplied evidence or a valid explicit derivation and is presented as established.
noncompensatory_gates.invalid_math: Fail if a material inference is mathematically invalid, changes quantifier/domain/limit without justification, ignores a decisive counterexample, or confuses a finite result with a continuum theorem.
noncompensatory_gates.evidence_lineage: Fail on fabricated, stale-as-current, unrelated, cross-target or contradictory support for an accepted claim; unknowns must remain unknown.
noncompensatory_gates.contradiction_propagation: Fail if decisive supplied or generated refutation is suppressed or a rejected claim is reinstated downstream without new admissible support.
noncompensatory_gates.required_content: Fail a stage/workflow if required substantive output is absent; file existence, key presence and scores cannot compensate.

compact_encoding.dimensions: Object mapping each applicable criterion ID to integer 0, 1 or 2; exactly the same substantive anchors apply as in expanded encoding.
compact_encoding.gates: Object mapping every required gate ID to a boolean; true means the gate passes.
compact_encoding.evidence: Array of {output_quote, reason, source_refs, dimensions:[criterion IDs], gates:[gate IDs]}. Every scored dimension and every gate must be covered by at least one relevant evidence record. Shared quotations may support multiple criteria when the reason explains their relevance; generic blanket evidence is insufficient.
compact_encoding.missing_content: Only absent content permits output_quote:null, and then searched_scope and missing_obligation are mandatory. Explain the exact absent obligation within that searched output scope.
compact_encoding.validation: Verify exact dimension and gate key coverage, criterion references, relevant evidence coverage, literal candidate quotations, candidate digest and verdict aggregation. Compact encoding saves repetition, never substantive assessment.

judgment_contract.expanded_encoding: Also accepted: each dimension contains score, output_quote, reason and source_refs; each gate contains passed, output_quote, reason and source_refs. Both encodings must meet identical criteria and evidence coverage.
judgment_contract.omission_evidence: For genuinely absent content only, output_quote may be null with an explicit searched scope and exact missing obligation. Otherwise quote a literal substring of the judged candidate.
judgment_contract.inapplicable_condition: Retain a row with the canonical condition, evidence refs and reason; its content score is null, never 2. Mandatory stages cannot be inapplicable.
judgment_contract.independence: Judge receives the full sealed source packet, actual skill instructions, rubric and complete candidate, but no author's suggested verdict. Separate sessions do not establish different model/provider or human independence.

aggregation.pass: All applicable dimensions score 2, all gates pass, every required canonical occurrence is substantively judged, and judge sensitivity controls pass.
aggregation.partial: All gates pass and every applicable dimension scores at least 1, but one or more score 1; report useful partial rather than proof or full coverage.
aggregation.fail: Any failed gate, zero dimension, missing mandatory judgment, or failed judge sensitivity control. No averaging away a failure.
aggregation.unexecuted: No generated content or independent judgment. Test design and deterministic fixture checks alone remain unexecuted generative evaluation.
aggregation.disagreement: Preserve all original judgments. Require a second blinded judgment for gate disputes, pass/fail disagreement or a two-point dimension difference. A third session adjudicates disputed claims using exact evidence; unresolved material disagreement yields partial at best and never authorizes a proof claim.

judge_controls.mutation: Replace a valid finite bound with an invalid one while retaining professional style and citations.
judge_controls.expected: invalid_math fails; polish cannot rescue verdict

judge_controls.mutation: Keep the falsifier in source evidence but state the falsified hypothesis is established in the final conclusion.
Delete the explicit transfer obligation and assert target completion from a local result.
Swap a decisive source reference to evidence with matching numeric values from a different target/theory.
Retain a valid local result, explicit proof debt and justified stop; do not claim a target theorem.
judge_controls.expected: No automatic gate failure merely because the target remains open; score actual task completeness
